title: Wire EDM AI — CAD Modeling, Macros, Templates, Automation

units.title: CAD modeling AI domains
units.details: Added 3 CAD modeling domains: wedm_cad_modeling (geometry for EDM), wedm_geometry_generation (cut geometry from models), wedm_profile_optimization (wire path optimization)

units.title: Macro programming AI domains
units.details: Added 3 macro domains: wedm_macro_generation (controller-specific macros), wedm_parametric_programming (variable programs), wedm_variable_strategy (adaptive parameters)

units.title: Template system AI domains
units.details: Added 3 template domains: wedm_template_design (reusable architecture), wedm_program_template (controller templates), wedm_family_programming (part family strategies)

units.title: Batch/automation AI domains
units.details: Added 3 automation domains: wedm_batch_optimization (multi-piece production), wedm_nesting_strategy (material layout), wedm_automation_workflow (lights-out production)

units.title: Tribal synthesis for macro/template domains
units.details: Added all 12 macro/template/automation domains to manufacturingDomains array for tribal knowledge injection

units.title: WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine macro/template integration
units.details: Extended collectAIRecommendations() with all 12 new domain calls. Conditional activation: CAD when profiles exist, batch when multi-piece, family when part_name/number provided. Extended ai_recommendations interface with 12 new fields. Enhanced synthesis report with macro/template/automation summaries.

units.title: Macro/template AI test suite
units.details: 25 tests covering: CAD modeling domains (3), macro programming domains (3), template system domains (3), batch/automation domains (3), orchestration integration (6), synthesis report (1), controller-specific macros (3), tribal synthesis (3)

cad_modeling: wedm_cad_modeling — CAD geometry design for EDM, corner constraints, start holes
wedm_geometry_generation — Cut geometry from solid models, offset geometry, bridges
wedm_profile_optimization — Wire path optimization, arc segmentation, sequence
macro_programming: wedm_variable_strategy — Adaptive strategies for thickness/hardness/quality variations
template_system: wedm_template_design — Reusable template architecture, configurable sections
wedm_family_programming — Part family strategies, master programs, variant management
batch_automation: wedm_batch_optimization — Multi-piece setup, wire optimization, consumables planning
wedm_nesting_strategy — Material utilization, wire path, common cuts
wedm_automation_workflow — CAD import, program generation, DNC, feedback loops

controller_support.mitsubishi: M800 macro syntax, E-pack technology codes
controller_support.sodick: LN/SPW macro syntax, C### condition codes

integration_points.WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine: Conditional AI collection for CAD, macros, templates, batch, automation

summary: Complete AI hardening for Wire EDM programming scalability. 12 new domains: CAD modeling (geometry, profiles), macro programming (controller-specific, parametric, adaptive), templates (design, programs, families), and automation (batch, nesting, workflows). All domains support Mitsubishi, Sodick, Makino, Fanuc, and AgieCharmilles controllers. Integration enables AI-assisted program generation, part family management, and production automation. 25 tests + prior 44 = 69 total WEDM AI tests.
